To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday — draft, not sent

Renee, here's our rundown for the admin meeting. Been a good week for these kids and a lot of folks helped make it happen.

We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday to finish second in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met. That says something when your teammates pick you like that. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 touchdowns. His long touchdown in the third quarter was a big one, but give that offensive line their credit too. They were pushing them 5 yards back that whole drive. Best I've seen them block all year. Defense held Brookhollow to 46 rushing yards in the second half.

Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows we've got a HOME playoff game. We host Clanton Valley this Friday, Nov. 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. We'd love to have folks come out for these boys. Presale tickets start Tuesday. Gate and chain crews still need confirming by Wednesday, and boosters need 6 more people for concessions. That signup sheet goes out today.

All 52 players are eligible after the nine-week grade check. Nobody on the list. Tonya Greer deserves the credit for that, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is paying off, and she's keeping it going through the playoffs.

The Boston butt sale brought in $6,240 on 208 sold, beating the $4,500 goal by $1,740. That money is going toward the new sideline headsets. Big thanks to Carla, the boosters, and Hargrove's Meat Market for doing the smoking at cost.

If we win and go on the road, I'll get the bus stuff to you. I've got that five-day notice requirement in mind.
